_finding: simulate_buy reads the B20 rules from memory first (docs/b20-transfers-tz.md §4, outside review of #268): on Base a current chain pause decides over the issuer's list, which is the fallback only when the chain gave none; a stale reading never refuses; a venue is checked in the role it plays in the stock token's transfer (the pool that pays, the KyberSwap router and delivering pool, the router that pulls the sell-back); a wallet the receiver policy refuses gets would_revert without a swap, one the sender policy refuses no sell-back; and nothing is attributed to the issuer from the ordinary wallet.

mutations.name: paused on chain is not refused
mutations.expect: FAIL transfers paused on chain: refused

mutations.name: a stale reading refuses
mutations.expect: FAIL a stale reading never refuses

mutations.name: the issuer's list overrides the chain
mutations.find: const pauseFrom = chainPause === null ? current : { paused: [] }
mutations.expect: FAIL unpaused on chain, still paused on the issuer

mutations.name: the issuer's list is never the fallback
mutations.find: const pauseFrom = chainPause === null ? current : { paused: [] }
mutations.expect: FAIL no current chain answer: the issuer

mutations.name: a refused KyberSwap router is asked anyway
mutations.expect: FAIL the KyberSwap router refused as executor

mutations.name: the Aerodrome router is checked as if it moved the token on a buy
mutations.replace: C.routers.some(refusedVenue) ? Promise.resolve(notAllowed('aerodrome')) : inTime(aeroQ(stable, address, amountIn, true), lateQuote('aerodrome')),
mutations.expect: FAIL the Aerodrome router refused as executor: the single-pool buy is still quoted

mutations.name: a refused pool is quoted anyway
mutations.expect: FAIL the pool the quote chose

mutations.name: the KyberSwap delivering pool is not checked
mutations.find: if (second.result === 'ok' && (Array.isArray(second.deliveringPools) ? second.deliveringPools : [second.deliveringPool]).some((p) => refusedVenue(p, SENDS))) second = notAllowed('kyberswap')
mutations.expect: FAIL ...and the KyberSwap route that delivers from the same pool

mutations.name: the sell-back router is not checked
mutations.expect: FAIL ...but the sell-back, which that router pulls

mutations.name: a wallet refused as sender still gets a sell-back
mutations.find: : issuerPolicy && issuerPolicy.send === false ? Promise.resolve({ result: 'unknown', reason: 'wallet_not_allowed_by_issuer', source: C.primary, quotedAt: null })
mutations.expect: FAIL a wallet the sender policy refuses

mutations.name: a refused wallet still runs the swap
mutations.expect: FAIL a wallet the receiver policy refuses: would_revert

mutations.name: the ordinary wallet is taken as the caller
mutations.find: const sim = sim0 && !walletRefused ? attributeIssuer(sim0, issuerPolicy) : sim0
mutations.replace: const sim = sim0 && !walletRefused ? attributeIssuer(sim0, transfers && transfers.ordinary_wallet && transfers.ordinary_wallet.receive === false ? { ...(issuerPolicy || {}), receive: false } : issuerPolicy) : sim0
mutations.expect: FAIL ...and a token revert there stays token_rule

mutations.name: only the first delivering pool of a split route is checked
mutations.expect: FAIL a split KyberSwap route whose second delivering pool is refused

mutations.name: the sell-back checks the buy pool
mutations.expect: FAIL the sell-back through another pool, that pool refused as a receiver

mutations.name: the sell-back pool is not checked
mutations.expect: FAIL the Aerodrome pool refused as a receiver
